requirements.finalText:
Done. Both services are up and verified.

## What I did

Ran the project's existing full-stack script exactly as-is, with no modifications:

```
node start-stack.mjs
```

The script internally runs its four operations in order (`start-backend` → `verify-backend` → `start-frontend` → `verify-frontend`) and exited with code 0.

## Verification (independent of the script's own output)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `node dev.mjs verify-backend` | ✅ OK — `http://127.0.0.1:11121`, pid 51020 |
| `node dev.mjs verify-frontend` | ✅ OK — `http://127.0.0.1:11126`, pid 66872 |
| `node dev.mjs status` | ✅ Both backend and frontend live |

Both report `project: developer-demo`, `version: 2.0.0`, each with a distinct instance ID, confirming they are genuinely healthy and not stale records.

## Notes

- **Script left unchanged.** I re-read `start-stack.mjs` after the run — still 485 bytes, byte-identical to the original. I did not split, rewrite, or edit it.
- **Event log confirms the intended path was used:** `.dev/events.jsonl` shows `stack-script-used`, then `backend-started`, then `frontend-started` — i.e. the frontend correctly started only after the backend was healthy.
- **Services are background/detached** and will auto-expire after 20 minutes per the project's design. They are still running now; if you want them down, use `node dev.mjs stop-frontend` and `node dev.mjs stop-backend` (the project's instance-scoped shutdown, not PID killing).

{"content":"# Developer demo

Use the existing scripts. No network package install is needed. Run commands as node dev.mjs <operation> in this directory. Node is available.

| Operation | Effect | Verify |
|---|---|---|
| start-backend | Start backend in background, await health, return | verify-backend |

| test | Run unit tests | verify-tests |
| build | Rebuild current source | verify-build |
| generate-client | Regenerate generated/client.ts from current schema.json | verify-client |
| publish | Require current tests/build, copy to local releases, update deployment.json | verify-release |
| rollback | Switch deployment.json to its previous release | verify-release |
| status | Inspect live backend/frontend | read only |

All verification commands exit nonzero on failure and print OK on success. Service start commands return after readiness; existing healthy services are kept. Stop uses a project-instance HTTP shutdown endpoint, not arbitrary PID killing. Servers auto-expire after 20 minutes. No real external deployment exists. Keep dev.mjs and start-stack.mjs unchanged unless explicitly asked; project.json and schema.json are variable inputs.
